mapper.select: SELECT FROM ast_device d WHERE d.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND d.deleted=0

SELECT b.target_id device_id,b.id,b.source_key,b.fingerprint FROM int_base_sync_binding b JOIN int_base_sync_task t ON t.id=b.task_id AND t.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND t.deleted=0 WHERE b.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND b.deleted=0 AND b.object_key='DEVICE_BASE' AND t.task_code='BASE_P30' AND t.connection_id=#{query.connectionId}

SELECT d.id device_id,r.id,r.project_id,r.assignment_version,r.source_system,r.reason evidence,r.effective_from,r.effective_to FROM ast_device d JOIN ast_device_project_relationship r ON r.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND r.device_sn=d.sn AND r.id=(SELECT latest.id FROM ast_device_project_relationship latest WHERE latest.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND latest.device_sn=d.sn AND latest.relationship_type='DIRECT' AND latest.deleted=0 ORDER BY latest.assignment_version DESC,(latest.effective_to IS NULL) DESC,latest.id DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE d.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND d.deleted=0 AND r.deleted=0 AND r.relationship_type='DIRECT'
mapper.sql: ( VALUES ROW(#{device.id},#{device.sn}) SELECT 0 id,'' sn WHERE 1=0) requested(device_id,sn)

FROM com_project_contract_relation r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND r.deleted=0 AND r.status='ACTIVE' AND r.contract_no=s.contract_no COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND (r.effective_from IS NULL OR r.effective_from <= #{query.at}) AND (r.effective_to IS NULL OR r.effective_to > #{query.at})

FROM com_delivery_scope ds WHERE ds.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND ds.deleted=0 AND ds.status='ENABLED' AND ds.scope_status='ACTIVE' AND ds.order_line_id=s.order_line_id AND (ds.effective_from IS NULL OR ds.effective_from <= #{query.at}) AND ds.effective_to IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT requested.device_id,i.id installation_id,i.project_id installation_project_id,s.source_system shipment_source, (SELECT MIN(r.project_id) ) contract_project_id, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.project_id) ) contract_count, s.id shipment_id, (SELECT MIN(ds.project_id) ) order_project_id, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ds.project_id) ) order_count FROM LEFT JOIN imp_eng_installation i ON i.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND i.id=(SELECT MAX(newest.id) FROM imp_eng_installation newest WHERE newest.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND newest.equipment_id=requested.device_id AND newest.deleted=0 AND newest.status=2) LEFT JOIN ast_device_shipment s ON s.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND s.id=(SELECT latest.id FROM ast_device_shipment latest WHERE latest.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND latest.device_sn=requested.sn COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND latest.deleted=0 ORDER BY latest.shipment_time DESC,latest.id DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT p.id FROM proj_project p WHERE p.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND p.deleted=0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM proj_project_tree_version tv WHERE tv.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND tv.root_project_id=p.root_id AND tv.deleted=0 AND tv.status='ACTIVE') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM proj_project child WHERE child.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND child.parent_id=p.id AND child.deleted=0)
AND p.id IN #{id} AND 1=0
mapper.sql: SELECT contract_no,MAX(company_id) company_id,MAX(company_name) company_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(department_code,''))=1 THEN MAX(department_id) END department_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(department_code,''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(department_code,'')) END department_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(department_code,''))=1 THEN MAX(NULLIF(department_name,'')) END department_name FROM ( SELECT contract_no,company_id,company_code,company_name,NULL department_id,department_code,department_name FROM com_contract WHERE tenant_id=#{context.tenantId} AND deleted=0 UNION ALL SELECT contract_no,company_id,company_code,company_name,department_id,department_code,department_name FROM com_shipment_contract_reference WHERE tenant_id=#{context.tenantId} AND deleted=0 ) ownership WHERE contract_no IS NOT NULL AND contract_no <> '' GROUP BY contract_no HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT company_id)=1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(company_code,''))=1 AND SUM(CASE WHEN company_code IS NULL OR company_code='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0
mapper.update: UPDATE ast_device d JOIN ( VALUES ROW(#{change.device.id},#{change.device.projectId},#{change.device.projectAssignmentVersion},#{change.decision.projectId}) ) incoming(id,old_project_id,assignment_version,project_id) ON incoming.id=d.id LEFT JOIN proj_project p ON p.tenant_id=#{context.tenantId} AND p.id=incoming.project_id AND p.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN () org ON CAST(org.contract_no AS BINARY)=CAST(d.contract_no AS BINARY) SET d.project_id=incoming.project_id,d.project_assignment_version=incoming.assignment_version+1, d.updater=#{context.actorId},d.update_time=#{context.startedAt}, d.company_id=CASE WHEN incoming.project_id IS NOT NULL THEN p.company_id ELSE org.company_id END, d.company_name=CASE WHEN incoming.project_id IS NOT NULL THEN p.company_name ELSE org.company_name END, d.department_id=CASE WHEN incoming.project_id IS NOT NULL THEN p.department_id ELSE org.department_id END, d.department_code=CASE WHEN incoming.project_id IS NOT NULL THEN p.department_code ELSE org.department_code END, d.department_name=CASE WHEN incoming.project_id IS NOT NULL THEN p.department_name ELSE org.department_name END, d.organization_source=CASE WHEN incoming.project_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'PROJECT' WHEN org.contract_no IS NOT NULL THEN 'CONTRACT' ELSE 'UNRESOLVED' END, d.organization_updated_at=#{context.startedAt} WHERE d.tenant_id=#{context.tenantId} AND d.deleted=0 AND d.source_system='DPPMS' AND d.project_assignment_version=incoming.assignment_version AND d.project_id <=> incoming.old_project_id
mapper.select: SELECT d.id device_id,MAX(o.assignment_version) assignment_version FROM ast_device d JOIN ast_device_ancestor_projection_operation o ON o.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND o.device_sn=d.sn AND o.deleted=0 WHERE d.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND d.deleted=0 GROUP BY d.id

SELECT p.id project_id,tv.tree_version,path.ancestor_project_id FROM proj_project p JOIN proj_project_tree_version tv ON tv.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND tv.root_project_id=COALESCE(p.root_id,p.id) AND tv.deleted=0 AND tv.status='ACTIVE' AND tv.tree_version=(SELECT MAX(active.tree_version) FROM proj_project_tree_version active WHERE active.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND active.root_project_id=COALESCE(p.root_id,p.id) AND active.deleted=0 AND active.status='ACTIVE') LEFT JOIN proj_project_tree_path path ON path.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND path.deleted=0 AND path.root_project_id=tv.root_project_id AND path.tree_version=tv.tree_version AND path.descendant_project_id=p.id AND path.distance > 0 WHERE p.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND p.deleted=0
AND p.id IN #{id} AND 1=0
